events.name: Power Failure
events.message: ⚡ The power just died! Flip the breakers in the fuse box on the west wall.
events.background: There is a loud electrical POP and the agent's office goes dead silent except for people screaming in the dark.

events.name: Headset Malfunction
events.message: 🎧 Your headset is screeching feedback! Grab a new one from the supply cabinet (south wall).
events.background: There is horrible ear-piercing microphone feedback on the line.

events.name: Boss Patrol
events.message: 👀 Mr. Chatterjee is patrolling the floor. Be on a call or at your computer when he reaches you!
events.background: A man is screaming 'QUOTA! QUOTA! WHERE IS MY MONEY?!' somewhere behind the agent.

events.name: Computer Virus
events.message: 🦠 Your own PC got a virus! Close the pop-ups and run the Antivirus app.
events.background: The agent's computer keeps playing loud error sounds and a voice saying 'YOUR COMPUTER HAS BEEN HACKED'.

events.name: Internet Outage
events.message: 📡 The internet is down! Reboot the router on the side table near the kitchen.
events.background: The agent is yelling 'IS THE WIFI DOWN?!' at someone.

events.name: Unexpected Visitor: A Cow
events.message: 🐄 A cow has wandered into the office. Gently shoo it out (walk up and press E a few times).
events.background: A cow is mooing VERY loudly right next to the agent.

events.name: Police Raid
events.message: 🚨 POLICE RAID! Shred the evidence at the shredder (near the boss's office) and hide under your desk (C) before they get upstairs!
events.background: Police sirens are wailing and someone outside is shouting through a megaphone: 'THIS IS THE POLICE, NOBODY MOVE!'

events.name: Office Fire
events.message: 🔥 Vikram microwaved a fork. THE OFFICE IS ON FIRE. Grab the extinguisher by the kitchen and put out the flames!
events.background: A fire alarm is blaring and people are screaming 'FIRE! FIRE!' on the agent's end.

events.name: Air Strike Drill (Hopefully)
events.message: ✈️ AIR RAID SIREN! Get under your desk (press C) NOW!
events.background: An air-raid siren is wailing and there are distant explosions on the agent's end. The agent sounds like they're under a desk.
